digest.component_or_area: rebar store auto-push and ticket event scanning
propositions: A rejected tickets-branch auto-push fails silently because the _NON_FF regex over-broadly matches the token 'rejected' in policy-decline lines, routing the stderr-bearing log call into the retry path and discarding the actual git rejection reason.
Ticket comment payloads containing live credentials are never scanned for secrets on write; the gitleaks gate sees code only, not the environments pasted into comments where the incident occurred.
The rejection signal is pull-only (via rebar fsck PUSH_PENDING) and does not propagate on write paths, so an escalating backlog of unpushed commits remains invisible across successive write commands.
The fix must preserve the best-effort contract (never fail the caller, return None, never raise) while surfacing the git rejection reason and unpushed commit count in the warning log.
